items.q: so I started to working with Dizzy Gillespie and Oscar Pettiford

ctx.x: So all right, that night I stayed on and rehearsed because he's not going to be there tomorrow night. I'm starting to work. So I run over the hits and everything, and they're showing me the different things, you know, and so I started to working with Dizzy Gillespie and Oscar Pettiford (inaudible).
